verdict.rationale: Docs confirm connecting an individual work email (Gmail/Outlook) to log replies and enable one-to-one email sync to CRM records, which addresses the core of the story. However, evidence doesn't explicitly confirm two-way sync (both sending and receiving auto-logged to right records) or details on matching/logging accuracy, contact-level automation nuances, or independent/hands-on verification. missing for 10: explicit two-way sync confirmation, details on automatic record-matching logic, independent/hands-on verification of reliability.
